predictions.label: Airlines halt Israel flights (by 30 Nov)
predictions.why: The rules are strict: at least 3 of Delta, United, Lufthansa, Air France and BA must each stop every Tel Aviv flight for 14 days in a row, overlapping by 30 Nov. Partial cuts (like Lufthansa's no-overnight rule or BA's route trims) don't count. That basically needs a major campaign within about 5 days, which the White House has signalled is unlikely. Below the thin, noisy market.
